DEN_Refugee
Pandirna is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. With her legs paralysed from a dodgy brew, she is given the duty of guarding the refugees' storage hut.
“
Never buying a potion off that old bat again.
„
— Pandirna, on her recent shopping experience

Overview

Pandirna was married to Almara, who passed away prior to Act One. In letters to her late wife, Pandirna expresses regret in not being able to prevent Almara's death. She now feels obligated to protect those around her.

Involvement

Act One

Pandirna guards the storage hut in the Emerald Grove. She drank a potion from  Auntie Ethel, who claimed she would become "as strong as a bugbear". Although the potion worked it also caused  Paralysis in Pandirna's legs, relegating her to guard duty.

Pandirna can be reached by lockpicking the front door or entering through the rear roof. Behind  Sazza's cage, a path leads around the cavern toward the rear of the storage hut. If the party attacks Pandirna, pickpockets her, or loots the nearby crates, she becomes hostile and calls for the guards.

To receive the dialogue option to offer Pandirna a cure, the party member who interacts with her must be a bard, cleric, druid, or paladin. The paralysis can be cured with  Lesser Restoration or the  Amulet of Silvanus. After being cured, Pandirna allows the party to wander the room, but not to touch anything.

The Dark Urge has the unique option of breaking Pandirna's legs, which kills her without alerting the guards. This is an oathbreaking action for all Paladins.

If the party cause hostilities in the area, Pandirna is  Knocked Out and  Paralysed, and they cannot interact with her. This can be done after promising to cure her, getting approvals, then telling her to wait.[verify]

If  Minthara and her raiding party are primed to assault the Emerald Grove, Pandirna will be fit once more and be atop the grove's ramparts alongside  Guex, busy filling up empty barrels with oil. If the raid is beaten back or the goblins' leaders are dead, Pandirna moves with the other tieflings near the entrance of the Grove, and makes preparations for the road ahead.

Idle banter

During the Emerald Grove assault, Pandirna will be rallied by  Asharak:

  • Asharak
    Looking well, folks - keep it up.
  • Guex
    Yes sir!
  • Asharak
    I'm not 'sir'. I was a doorjack in Elturel.
  • Pandirna
    'Yes sir'.
  • Guex
    Shut it, you - and help me with these barrels.
  • Asharak
    Remember - get down to the cave as soon as you hear the horn.
  • Guex
    What happens if they attack before we get the signal?
  • Asharak
    I reckon you'll hear something.
  • Asharak
    Almost done?
  • Pandirna
    Nearly. We've ransacked the packs for anything that'll burn.
  • Asharak
    Good. Reckon we can brave a few nights without lamp-light if it means burning these buggers.

Pandirna can also be seen chatting to  Guex while filling barrels of oil:

  • Pandirna
    Gods, this oil bloody stinks.
  • Guex
    Not so bad as burning goblin will, I'd wager.
  • Pandirna
    It seems... cruel, when you say it like that.
  • Guex
    Cruel? Imagine what they'd do to us, given half the chance.
  • Pandirna
    Can we just get this done, please? I want to get below before -
  • Guex
    Before what? Afraid you might actually have to fight?
  • Pandirna
    Look. Asharak already picked who he wanted on the walls, right? And it wasn't us.
  • Guex
    You might be afraid of your own shadow, but some of us -
  • Pandirna
    Puff out your chest all you like - I'm going where it's safe.
  • Guex
    Would you be careful? We're going to spill if you don't stop shaking.
  • Pandirna
    I'm not shaking.
  • Guex
    Please, you're trembling like -
  • Pandirna
    I'm not. Shaking.
  • Guex
    All right...
